title: Mutable default arguments
prompt: Type exactly what this program prints.

code.python:
def add_item(item, bucket=[]):
    bucket.append(item)
    return bucket

a = add_item(1)
b = add_item(2)
c = add_item(3, [])
print(a, b, c)
print(a is b)

hints: Default values are evaluated once, when the function is defined.
